archive: A. S. Hauck, M. Jin, B. R. Tuttle, "Structures and energies of GaN native point defects, divacancy, and carbon substitutional from hybrid functional calculations", Zenodo (2026), doi:10.5281/zenodo.21893631, CC BY 4.0; used in J. Appl. Phys. 139, 245702 (2026)
archive_description: Includes VASP structure files (POSCAR & CONTCAR) and select output files (OUTCAR & OSZICAR) of hybrid functional (HSE06) density-functional theory calculations for gallium nitride (GaN). Files are included for the perfect structure (96-atom supercell, no defects), native point defects (Ga/N vacancies, interstitials, and antisites), a Ga/N divacancy (VGa-VN), and a carbon substitutional atom on a N site (CN). Various charge states are included for each defect type. Information about the INCAR and KPOINT settings are detailed in the OUTCAR files.
naming: Folder names as released: perfect and its subfolders are defect-free supercells; defect folders are <defect><site label>_<charge>, e.g. Va_Ga1_-2 (Ga vacancy, q = -2), Va_N1 (N vacancy), Ga_i1/Ga_i2 and N_i1/N_i2 (two interstitial configurations each), Ga_N1 and N_Ga1 (antisites), VV_GaN1 (V_Ga-V_N divacancy), C_N1 (C on a N site).
